kaggle.title: Milo and Pippa: The Mystery Seed
kaggle.story:
Milo the little fox wore a blue scarf. His friend Pippa the rabbit wore a yellow vest.
One morning they found a seed beside their garden gate. Milo wanted to plant it in the shade,
but Pippa thought it needed sunshine. Instead of arguing, they asked Grandma Owl for help.
She showed them a sunny patch and helped them make a little hole. Milo covered the seed with
soft soil. Pippa brought a small cup of water. Every morning they took turns caring for it.
For several days they saw nothing. Milo almost gave up, but Pippa reminded him that growing
takes time. At last a tiny green leaf appeared. By summer their seed had become a bright
sunflower. Bees visited it, and Grandma Owl smiled. Milo and Pippa learned that patience
and working together could turn something small into something wonderful.

colab.title: Nori and Pip: The Missing Kite
colab.story: Nori the little turtle carried an orange backpack. His friend Pip the duck wore a green bow tie. One breezy morning they brought their red kite to the orchard. Before they could fly it, a gust lifted the kite from the picnic blanket. Its ribbon caught on a low apple-tree branch. Pip wanted to jump for it, but Nori noticed that the branch was too high. They stayed on the ground and asked Auntie Hedgehog for help. She brought a long soft garden hook and gently lowered the kite. Nori held the ribbon while Pip checked the frame. Together they carried it to an open grassy patch away from trees and roads. Auntie Hedgehog showed them how to take turns holding the string. Soon the red kite danced in the blue sky. Nori and Pip learned that asking for help and making a careful plan could turn a problem into a happy adventure.
